body:
Implemented in clean public source 0109ab462edade524667d20303507aa09adcbaf6, now the head of draft PR62. Actual shaderInt64 support is queried/reported/enabled only when advertised; unsupported or unenabled Int64 modules are refused before driver work. The four-file correction preserves all 35 shipped SPVs, Float64/FMA/portability policy and existing registration.

Finite acceptance passes: strict GCC14 and Clang21 C++26 builds of all seven executable roles; five affected original pure controls per compiler with zero failures/errors/skips; actual stock Lavapipe query/create/module/dispatch with supported and enabled Int64; independent 174268-record scalar corpus with 522804 exact words and zero mismatches. CI 39503255995 passes all three strict integration jobs and 30 named authority controls. Full runtime/scientific/sanitizer/native-window/frame/external-domain/release qualification is not established.

[Actual products, sources, raw logs, feature arguments, corpus, CI and ownership](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/99aa5e1b0887fe2c18619e5a124ccce259620523/attestations/qualification/0109ab46/int64-admission-and-divide64-rejected). The earlier accidental default ALL build was stopped and is preserved as failed/incomplete; it is not Mandatory acceptance. Later explicit seven-target builds pass. Historical GCC e067 outputs overwritten by the format-only44261267 refresh are not represented as retained binaries; actual Clang e067 and private e067 probes remain preserved. PR-triggered CI 39507921220 is separate and in progress.

The optional64 Endpoint speed experiment is rejected at 14/22 and excluded from PR62. This closes the admission defect only; #44/#48/#53 and the ultimate goal remain open.
